g.text: Descriptive normalized paths · smoke · dense · reward
SMOKE ONLY: full study not run. 4–4 paired repetitions/cell. Cells weighted equally; bands/bars are ±1 Monte Carlo SE. R/log(t) uses checkpoints after the layout's last arrival
only. No asymptotic constant is asserted for dense schedules. R/S(t) uses the current arrival spectrum; guards use its running maximum.
